message: Thanks! A few quick questions: Which state do you live in? How many children under 18 live with you (and is any under 5, or is anyone pregnant/baby under 1)? Roughly how much does your household earn from work per year before tax?
reply: We're in New York. One kid. $351,800 a year.

summary: NY household of 3 (married couple, one child) earning about $351,800 a year. That is well above the income limits for SNAP, WIC, TANF, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC, ACA premium tax credit and free or reduced-price school meals. The refundable child tax credit would be zero at this income because their tax bill absorbs the credit. SSI does not apply: no disability or age 65+ was reported, and I did not ask about disability. NY's Child Health Plus has no income cap but charges full premiums above 400% FPL, so I did not list it.
